name: image
description: Image layer, as in Moho: a picture (PNG, JPEG, WebP or a whole SVG) drawn from (0, 0) to (width, height) in the layer's own coordinates, for example a reference to draw over. The file lives in the document's assets folder and src is its name; add one with `aia image <doc> <file>` (it copies the file and sizes the layer). Move, turn and scale it with the layer transform (aia transform), as any layer. It holds no parts.
help: Image layer: a picture (PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG), for example a reference to draw over.

src.description: Name of the file in the document's assets folder ("face_ref.png"). aia image copies the file there and sets it; a name that is not there draws nothing.
src.help: The image file, in the document's assets folder.

width.description: Width of the picture in px, in the layer's own coordinates (it is stretched to fit). aia image sets it from the file's size, fitted to the artboard.
width.help: Width in px (the picture is stretched to fit).

height.description: Height of the picture in px, in the layer's own coordinates (it is stretched to fit).
height.help: Height in px (the picture is stretched to fit).

opacity.description: How opaque the picture is, from 0 (invisible) to 1. A reference to draw over is often 0.4–0.6.
opacity.help: Opacity, 0 to 1 (lower it to draw over a reference).
